Understand the Role of AI in Cyber
Develop a foundational understanding of cybersecurity applications of AI by exploring the evolving implications of both traditional and AI-specific security approaches for AI attacks, mitigation and threat tools.

Product Details
Understand cybersecurity applications of AI and review the definition and processes of the AI lifecycle. Learn about the evolving implications of both traditional and AI-specific security approaches for AI attacks, mitigation and threat tools. By the end of this course, you will have foundational knowledge that will enable you to engage with AI concepts confidently and recognize their potential in cybersecurity.
Learning Experience:
Video and text-based content
Case study learning activities
Assessment
Validation of Completion
24/7/365 technical support
Who Will Benefit
This course is designed for cybersecurity professionals at any level of their career who want to develop or review their operational perspective for applying AI to cybersecurity. No prerequisite knowledge is required.
Key Topics
Artificial intelligence and machine learning
Threats and mitigation
Learning Outcomes
Recognize the types of AI attacks
Describe basic AI mitigations strategies
Identify common AI threat tools
Benefits
Build foundational knowledge that will enable you to engage with AI concepts confidently and recognize their relevance and potential in cybersecurity
Participate in activities centered on real-world applications
Earn CPE credits
Program Completion
Learners have 60 days from the date of purchase to complete the entire course. Those who successfully complete this course will receive a digital Validation of Completion and earn continuing professional education (CPE) credits. We recommend that you download and retain the Validation of Completion for your personal records.
To receive a Validation of Completion and earn CPE credits, learners must:
Complete the learning experience
Pass the assessment
Complete the learning experience evaluation

CPE Credit Reporting
CPE credits earned from this learning experience will automatically be reported for ISC2 credentials on the first day of every month. Please allow up to 10 business days for processing.
CPE credits earned for this learning experience may also be eligible for continuing professional education credits for non-ISC2 certifications. Please visit the continuing education requirements established by the credentialing organization for eligibility.
For questions related to ISC2 CPE credits or the CPE portal not covered in the handbook, please contact us via our online form.
